notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The update 1.1 is now available. This update aims to fix bugs and add game improvements.


Patch note:

Inventory system
- Expanded inventory spaces.

Weapon system
- You can now sell weapons.
- Increased the damage of all weapons.
- Fixed a bug where some players were unable to shoot.

Other
- Infected sometimes spawn with ammo and meds when they die.
- Missions are now always replayable, not just at the end of the game.
- Deactivated the Classic Arena game mode; only the random weapon game mode is available now because it was causing some issues.
- Missions provide more money when completed.


I've received complaints about not being able to reset your game save. You can always do that in the game settings in the main menu, but be aware that you won't be able to retrieve your old save.

I'm working on a big update to drastically improve the game, more info is coming soon!

I hope you enjoy the game. Thanks, everyone!

notes.title: The future of Kill Them All
notes.content:
The Steam next fest is already over, thanks to everyone who added the game to their wishlist and/or tried the demo. I have read your feedback carefully and have changed plans for the future of the game, so here are the next updates planned before the release:

0.9.6 

Adding the final map to the game

AI Update
- Better infected (Smarter)

Inventory system
- Auto pickup item button
- Inventory UX overhaul
- Pickup item button

More sound effects


0.9.7

Weapons
- SMGs
- New assault rifles
- Dmrs
- New special weapons

New items
- Stimpacks
- Spare items

More sound effects


0.9.8

Character
- Kick ability
- Tactical resupply
- Health bar

More loot crates

More sound effects


0.9.9

Closed Beta Playtests

Arena game mode

More sound effects


1.0

Final adjustments

Game release !



Multiplayer is not planned, I know it would make the game much more interesting, but it would add a lot of development time and unfortunately, I'm starting to run out of money.

Thanks, everyone I can't wait to release the game!

notes.title: Demo updated ! (0.9.4.5) (Bug fixes)
notes.content:
Updated the demo to version 0.9.4.5. This patch aims to fix major bugs,
here are the bugs fixed:

- Sometimes the player appeared without weapons
- Some buttons in the UI did not work
- Buttons to add to the wishlist and leave a survey are now functional

Thanks, everyone for following the game, I can't wait to release it, 
Have fun!
